result: I made `explainers/antibiotic-resistance/explanation.md` as prose only, because the subject is a chain of causes (random variation, then selection by the drug, regrowth and spread) carried by a few worked numbers, so a diagram or interactive page wouldn't add anything. It passed the probe, the cold reads (nothing blocking) and the final blind test (all 14 items at full marks; the first run failed one item, and I fixed that); details are in `review/understanding.md`.
